$description: Today exceptions of the spacing roles (DTCG 2025.10): a place whose Today value differs from its role. Named `<role>--<pattern>`, the pattern spelling the Today value (`fixed-24` one value at every width, `12-16` phone then desktop). Today renders the value here; every preview mode renders the role (per axis for insets, per dimension for sizes). `families` lists the utility families generated for it; `resolution` is empty until the exception is resolved (dropped, moved or promoted). See design-system/tokens/spacing.decisions.md.
